description: This file defines various classes and interfaces related to handling method invocation responses in the Orleans serialization framework. It includes abstract base classes, concrete implementations for completed responses and exceptions, as well as serialization codecs and auxiliary classes for response management.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Abstract base class representing a method invocation response, including static methods for creating responses from exceptions or results, and properties for result and exception handling.

classes.name: CompletedResponse
classes.description: Singleton class representing a completed response with no result or exception.

classes.name: CompletedResponseActivator
classes.description: Activator class for creating instances of CompletedResponse.

classes.name: ExceptionResponse
classes.description: Represents a response that encapsulates an exception, throwing it upon result access.

classes.name: Response<TResult>
classes.description: Typed response class that holds a result of type TResult.

classes.name: ResponseCodec
classes.description: Abstract class for raw serialization of Response objects.

classes.name: PooledResponseCodec<TResult>
classes.description: Codec for serializing and deserializing Response<TResult> with pooling support.

classes.name: PooledResponseCopier<TResult>
classes.description: Deep copier for Response<TResult> for pooling and serialization.

classes.name: PooledResponseActivator<TResult>
classes.description: Activator for Response<TResult> instances from pool.

classes.name: ResponseExtensions
classes.description: Extension methods for Response classes, including ThrowIfExceptionResponse.

methods.name: FromException
methods.description: Creates an ExceptionResponse from an Exception.

methods.name: FromResult
methods.description: Creates a Response with a specified result.

methods.name: GetResult
methods.description: Retrieves the result of the response, cast to type T.
